query: SELECT c.id as conversation_id, c.title, c.createdAt as conversation_created, m.role, m.content, m.createdAt as message_created FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN messages m ON c.id = m.conversationId WHERE c.userId = 2 ORDER BY c.id, m.createdAt
